john_1678.name: John
john_1678.who: A member of the high priest's family who sat on the council that questioned Peter and John.
key: He gathered with Annas, Caiaphas, and Alexander to question Peter and John after a lame man was healed (Acts 4).
The council, unable to deny the miracle, warned the apostles and released them (Acts 4).

jonathan_1691.name: Jonathan
jonathan_1691.who: A grandson of Moses through Gershom who became priest to the tribe of Dan's carved image.
key: He is apparently the young Levite whom Micah hired as priest for his household shrine (Judges 17).
The Danites took Micah's image and priest and set them up in their new city of Dan (Judges 18).
He and his sons served as priests to the Danites until the captivity of the land (Judges 18).

jonathan_1694.name: Jonathan
jonathan_1694.who: One of David's mighty men, a son of Shagee the Hararite.
key: He is listed among David's elite warriors known as the thirty (2 Samuel 23).
Chronicles names him Jonathan son of Shagee the Hararite among David's mighty men (1 Chronicles 11).

jonathan_1702.name: Jonathan
jonathan_1702.who: A son of Kareah and brother of Johanan, an army captain in Judah after Jerusalem fell.
key: After Babylon took Jerusalem, he and Johanan came with their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah (Jeremiah 40).
Gedaliah urged these captains to serve the king of Babylon and settle in the land (Jeremiah 40).

joseph_1711.name: Joseph
joseph_1711.who: A man of the tribe of Issachar, father of Igal, one of the twelve spies.
key: His son Igal represented Issachar among the twelve men Moses sent to spy out Canaan (Numbers 13).
Igal was among the spies who brought back a bad report of the land (Numbers 13).

jotham_1734.name: Jotham
jotham_1734.who: The youngest son of Gideon, the only brother to escape Abimelech's massacre.
key: He survived by hiding when Abimelech killed his seventy brothers on one stone (Judges 9).
From Mount Gerizim he told Shechem's leaders a fable about the trees choosing a king (Judges 9).
He warned that fire would consume both Abimelech and Shechem, then fled to Beer (Judges 9).
His curse came true when Shechem and Abimelech destroyed each other (Judges 9).

jozabad_1737.name: Jozabad
jozabad_1737.who: One of two men named Jozabad among Manasseh's commanders who deserted to David.
key: As David went to Ziklag, he joined David as a chief of thousands in Manasseh (1 Chronicles 12).
These men helped David against the band of raiders and became commanders in his army (1 Chronicles 12).

jozabad_1738.name: Jozabad
jozabad_1738.who: One of two men named Jozabad among Manasseh's commanders who deserted to David.
key: As David went to Ziklag, he joined David as a chief of thousands in Manasseh (1 Chronicles 12).
These men helped David against the band of raiders and became commanders in his army (1 Chronicles 12).

judah_1752.name: Judah
judah_1752.who: A Levite in Ezra's day who had married a foreign woman after the return from exile.
key: He is listed among the Levites who had married foreign women (Ezra 10).
The assembly agreed with Ezra to put away such marriages and keep the covenant (Ezra 10).

judah_1753.name: Judah
judah_1753.who: A Benjaminite son of Hassenuah who was second in charge over Jerusalem after the exile.
key: When the people resettled Jerusalem, he served as second over the city (Nehemiah 11).
He served with Joel son of Zichri, the overseer of the Benjaminites there (Nehemiah 11).

judah_1754.name: Judah
judah_1754.who: A Levite who returned from exile with Zerubbabel and Jeshua.
key: He is listed among the Levites who came up from Babylon with Zerubbabel (Nehemiah 12).
A Judah also walked with the leaders in the procession dedicating Jerusalem's wall (Nehemiah 12).

judah_1755.name: Judah
judah_1755.who: A Levite musician, a kinsman of Zechariah, at the dedication of Jerusalem's wall.
key: He played the musical instruments of David in the procession dedicating the wall (Nehemiah 12).
Ezra the scribe led his group along the wall toward the Fountain Gate (Nehemiah 12).

jude_1756.name: Jude
jude_1756.who: A brother of Jesus and of James, who wrote the Letter of Jude.
key: He is named among Jesus' brothers when Nazareth took offense at Jesus (Matthew 13).
During Jesus' ministry his brothers did not yet believe in him (John 7).
After the ascension, Jesus' brothers joined the apostles in prayer in Jerusalem (Acts 1).
Calling himself a servant of Jesus Christ, he urged believers to contend for the faith (Jude 1).

julius_1763.name: Julius
julius_1763.who: A Roman centurion of the Augustan Cohort who escorted Paul by sea to Rome.
key: He was given charge of Paul and other prisoners sailing for Italy (Acts 27).
He treated Paul kindly, letting him visit friends at Sidon (Acts 27).
He followed the pilot and ship's owner rather than Paul's warning not to sail (Acts 27).
In the shipwreck he stopped the soldiers from killing the prisoners, wishing to save Paul (Acts 27).

kenaz_1776.name: Kenaz
kenaz_1776.who: A grandson of Esau through Eliphaz who became a chief in Edom.
key: He is listed among the sons of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn (Genesis 36).
He was one of the chiefs descended from Esau in the land of Edom (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats him among Eliphaz's sons (1 Chronicles 1).

kenaz_1777.name: Kenaz
kenaz_1777.who: A chief of Edom named in the later list of Esau's clan chiefs.
key: He is listed among the chiefs of Edom by their clans and dwelling places (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats his name among the chiefs of Edom (1 Chronicles 1).

kenaz_1779.name: Kenaz
kenaz_1779.who: A grandson of Caleb son of Jephunneh, listed in the genealogy of Judah.
key: Chronicles lists him as the son of Elah, son of Caleb son of Jephunneh (1 Chronicles 4).
His father Elah was one of Caleb's three sons, with Iru and Naam (1 Chronicles 4).

keturah_1782.name: Keturah
keturah_1782.who: A wife of Abraham whose sons were sent east and fathered peoples such as Midian.
key: Abraham took another wife named Keturah (Genesis 25).
She bore him Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah (Genesis 25).
Abraham gave her sons gifts and sent them east, away from Isaac (Genesis 25).
Chronicles calls her Abraham's concubine and lists her descendants (1 Chronicles 1).

kish_1785.name: Kish
kish_1785.who: A Merarite Levite, son of Mahli, whose family served in David's Levite divisions.
key: He is listed with his brother Eleazar as sons of Mahli in David's Levite divisions (1 Chronicles 23).
Eleazar had only daughters, and Kish's sons married them (1 Chronicles 23).
His son Jerahmeel headed a Levite family that cast lots for service (1 Chronicles 24).

kittim_1789.name: Kittim
kittim_1789.who: A son of Javan in the Table of Nations, ancestor of a seafaring coastland people.
key: He is listed among the sons of Javan, son of Japheth (Genesis 10).
From Javan's sons the coastland peoples spread out in their lands (Genesis 10).
Chronicles repeats him among Javan's sons (1 Chronicles 1).

korah_1793.name: Korah
korah_1793.who: A son of Esau by Oholibamah, born in Canaan, who became a chief in Edom.
key: Oholibamah bore him to Esau in Canaan, with his brothers Jeush and Jalam (Genesis 36).
He became one of the chiefs descended from Esau (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats him among Esau's sons (1 Chronicles 1).

korah_1794.name: Korah
korah_1794.who: An Edomite chief listed among the descendants of Eliphaz, Esau's firstborn.
key: He is named among the chiefs of the sons of Eliphaz in Edom (Genesis 36).
These chiefs descended from Adah, Esau's wife and Eliphaz's mother (Genesis 36).

kore_1797.name: Kore
kore_1797.who: A Korahite Levite, son of Ebiasaph, whose sons led the temple gatekeepers.
key: His son Shallum and their kinsmen guarded the thresholds of the tent, as their fathers had (1 Chronicles 9).
His son Meshelemiah headed a family of gatekeepers in David's time (1 Chronicles 26).

lahmi_1806.name: Lahmi
lahmi_1806.who: A Philistine warrior, brother of Goliath, killed by Elhanan in David's wars.
key: In renewed war with the Philistines, Elhanan son of Jair struck him down (1 Chronicles 20).
He was among the descendants of the giants in Gath who fell to David's men (1 Chronicles 20).

laish_1807.name: Laish
laish_1807.who: A man of Gallim, father of Palti, to whom Saul gave David's wife Michal.
key: Saul gave Michal, David's wife, to his son Palti of Gallim (1 Samuel 25).
Later Ish-bosheth took Michal from his son and returned her to David (2 Samuel 3).

lamech_1808.name: Lamech
lamech_1808.who: A descendant of Cain who took two wives and boasted of avenging himself.
key: He took two wives, Adah and Zillah (Genesis 4).
His sons Jabal, Jubal, and Tubal-cain began herding, music, and metalworking (Genesis 4).
He boasted to his wives that he had killed a man for wounding him (Genesis 4).
He claimed vengeance seventy-sevenfold, far beyond Cain's sevenfold (Genesis 4).

lapidoth_1810.name: Lapidoth
lapidoth_1810.who: The husband of Deborah, the prophetess who judged Israel.
key: Deborah is introduced as a prophetess and the wife of Lapidoth (Judges 4).
In those days Deborah judged Israel and summoned Barak to fight Sisera (Judges 4).

lazarus_1811.name: Lazarus
lazarus_1811.who: The poor beggar in Jesus' story of the rich man and Lazarus.
key: He lay covered with sores at a rich man's gate, longing for scraps (Luke 16).
When he died, angels carried him to Abraham's side, while the rich man suffered (Luke 16).
Abraham refused to send him to warn the rich man's five brothers (Luke 16).

lemuel_1817.name: Lemuel
lemuel_1817.who: A king whose mother's teaching is recorded in the final chapter of Proverbs.
key: Proverbs records the words his mother taught him as king (Proverbs 31).
She warned him against women and wine and urged him to defend the poor and needy (Proverbs 31).

lo-ammi_1827.name: Lo-ammi
lo-ammi_1827.who: The third child of Gomer, Hosea's wife, whose name announced judgment on Israel.
key: Gomer bore him after weaning her daughter Lo-ruhamah (Hosea 1).
God named him to declare that Israel was not his people (Hosea 1).
God promised that one day Israel would be called children of the living God (Hosea 1).
God later promises to say to Not My People, You are my people (Hosea 2).

lo-ruhamah_1829.name: Lo-ruhamah
lo-ruhamah_1829.who: The daughter of Gomer, Hosea's wife, whose name announced God's withdrawn mercy from Israel.
key: Gomer bore a daughter after her son Jezreel (Hosea 1).
God named her to show he would no longer have mercy on Israel (Hosea 1).
God said he would still have mercy on Judah and save them himself (Hosea 1).
God later promises to have mercy on No Mercy (Hosea 2).

lois_1828.name: Lois
lois_1828.who: The grandmother of Timothy, whose sincere faith Paul remembered.
key: Paul recalled the sincere faith that dwelt first in Timothy's grandmother Lois (2 Timothy 1).
That same faith lived in Timothy's mother Eunice and in Timothy himself (2 Timothy 1).

lucius_1833.name: Lucius
lucius_1833.who: A prophet and teacher from Cyrene in the church at Antioch.
key: He was among the prophets and teachers at Antioch when the Spirit set apart Barnabas and Saul (Acts 13).
A Lucius, called Paul's kinsman, sent greetings to the church in Rome (Romans 16).

lydia_1837.name: Lydia
lydia_1837.who: A seller of purple goods from Thyatira, the first recorded believer in Philippi through Paul.
key: A worshiper of God, she heard Paul speak by the riverside at Philippi (Acts 16).
The Lord opened her heart, and she and her household were baptized (Acts 16).
She urged Paul and his companions to stay at her house (Acts 16).
After their release from prison, Paul and Silas visited the believers at her house (Acts 16).

maacah_1839.name: Maacah
maacah_1839.who: A wife of David, daughter of King Talmai of Geshur, and mother of Absalom.
key: She bore Absalom, David's third son, at Hebron (2 Samuel 3).
After killing Amnon, Absalom fled to her father Talmai in Geshur for three years (2 Samuel 13).
Chronicles lists her among the mothers of David's sons born at Hebron (1 Chronicles 3).

maaseiah_1866.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1866.who: Father of Zephaniah, a leading priest in Jerusalem during King Zedekiah's reign.
key: His son Zephaniah was sent by Zedekiah to ask Jeremiah to inquire of the LORD (Jeremiah 21).
Shemaiah wrote from Babylon urging his son Zephaniah to restrain Jeremiah (Jeremiah 29).
His son again carried Zedekiah's request for Jeremiah to pray for the people (Jeremiah 37).

maaseiah_1867.name: Maaseiah
maaseiah_1867.who: Father of Zedekiah, a false prophet among the exiles in Babylon.
key: His son Zedekiah prophesied lies in the LORD's name among the exiles (Jeremiah 29).
Jeremiah foretold that the king of Babylon would roast Zedekiah and Ahab in the fire (Jeremiah 29).

machir_1878.name: Machir
machir_1878.who: A man of Lo-debar who sheltered Mephibosheth and later supplied David in exile.
key: Mephibosheth was living in his house at Lo-debar when David sent for him (2 Samuel 9).
He brought beds, food, and supplies to David at Mahanaim during Absalom's revolt (2 Samuel 17).

maharai_1890.name: Maharai
maharai_1890.who: A Netophathite of the Zerahite clan, one of David's mighty men and a division commander.
key: He is listed among David's thirty mighty men (2 Samuel 23).
He commanded the army division of 24,000 that served in the tenth month (1 Chronicles 27).

maher-shalal-hash-baz_1894.name: Maher-shalal-hash-baz
maher-shalal-hash-baz_1894.who: A son of Isaiah whose name was a sign of Assyria's coming plunder of Damascus and Samaria.
key: God told Isaiah to write the name on a large tablet before reliable witnesses (Isaiah 8).
The prophetess bore a son, and the LORD told Isaiah to give him this name (Isaiah 8).
Before he could say father or mother, Assyria would plunder Damascus and Samaria (Isaiah 8).

mahli_1896.name: Mahli
mahli_1896.who: A Merarite Levite, son of Mushi, whose family served in David's Levite divisions.
key: He appears in the ancestry of Ethan, a Levite singer appointed in David's time (1 Chronicles 6).
He is listed with Eder and Jeremoth as sons of Mushi in David's Levite divisions (1 Chronicles 23).
His family is named again when the Levites cast lots for service (1 Chronicles 24).

malachi_1899.name: Malachi
malachi_1899.who: The prophet whose book of the LORD's word to Israel closes the Old Testament.
key: His book opens as the oracle of the LORD's word to Israel by Malachi (Malachi 1).
He rebuked the priests for offering blemished animals on the LORD's altar (Malachi 1).
He announced that the LORD would send his messenger to prepare the way (Malachi 3).
He foretold that Elijah would come before the great day of the LORD (Malachi 4).

malchi-shua_1990.name: Malchi-shua
malchi-shua_1990.who: A son of King Saul who died with his father and brothers on Mount Gilboa.
key: He is named with Jonathan and Ishvi among the sons of Saul (1 Samuel 14).
The Philistines killed him with Jonathan and Abinadab on Mount Gilboa (1 Samuel 31).
The men of Jabesh-gilead recovered the bodies of Saul and his sons and buried them (1 Samuel 31).

malchiel_1908.name: Malchiel
malchiel_1908.who: A grandson of Asher who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family.
key: He went down to Egypt with Jacob as a son of Beriah, son of Asher (Genesis 46).
He became the ancestor of the Malchielite clan in the tribe of Asher (Numbers 26).
Chronicles names him the father of Birzaith (1 Chronicles 7).

malchijah_1909.name: Malchijah
malchijah_1909.who: A priest named in the ancestry of Adaiah, a priest who served in Jerusalem after the exile.
key: Adaiah's line is traced through Jeroham and Pashhur back to Malchijah (1 Chronicles 9).
Nehemiah also records this priestly line among those living in Jerusalem (Nehemiah 11).

malchijah_1911.name: Malchijah
malchijah_1911.who: A returned exile named in Ezra's list of men who had married foreign women.
key: He is listed among the Israelites who had married foreign women (Ezra 10).
The assembly agreed with Ezra to put away such marriages (Ezra 10).

malchijah_1912.name: Malchijah
malchijah_1912.who: A son of Harim who helped rebuild Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.
key: He and Hasshub repaired a section of the wall and the Tower of the Ovens (Nehemiah 3).
The wall was finished in fifty-two days despite fierce opposition (Nehemiah 6).

mamre_1923.name: Mamre
mamre_1923.who: An Amorite near Hebron, brother of Eshcol and Aner, and an ally of Abram.
key: Abram lived by the oaks of Mamre the Amorite, who was allied with him (Genesis 14).
After Abram rescued Lot, he asked that Mamre receive his share of the spoil (Genesis 14).
Later the LORD appeared to Abraham by the oaks of Mamre (Genesis 18).

manahath_1927.name: Manahath
manahath_1927.who: A Horite descendant of Seir, son of Shobal, living in the land later called Edom.
key: He is listed among the sons of Shobal, son of Seir the Horite (Genesis 36).
Chronicles repeats him among the descendants of Seir (1 Chronicles 1).

mary_1941.name: Mary
mary_1941.who: The mother of John Mark, whose house in Jerusalem was a gathering place for the church.
key: Many believers gathered at her house to pray while Peter was in prison (Acts 12).
Freed by an angel, Peter went to her house, where Rhoda answered his knock (Acts 12).

matthias_1972.name: Matthias
matthias_1972.who: The disciple chosen by lot to replace Judas Iscariot among the twelve apostles.
key: He had followed Jesus from John's baptism until the ascension (Acts 1).
He and Joseph called Barsabbas were put forward, and the apostles prayed (Acts 1).
The lot fell on him, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles (Acts 1).

mattithiah_1973.name: Mattithiah
mattithiah_1973.who: A Korahite Levite, firstborn of Shallum, in charge of baking the flat cakes.
key: As Shallum's firstborn, he was trusted with making the flat cakes for the temple (1 Chronicles 9).
He served among the Levites who lived in Jerusalem after the return from exile (1 Chronicles 9).
